news.title: Search begins for CALS dean
news.summary_en: Members of the UW–Madison community can give input to the search committee through an online survey or at public listening sessions on Nov. 18 and 19.

news.title: Save the dates: UW–Madison Chancellor finalist presentations
news.summary_en: Faculty, staff and students, as well as alumni and members of the public, are encouraged to attend the sessions the week of Nov. 9.

news.title: Robert George, Cornel West: Truth-seeking starts with admitting you might be wrong
news.summary_en: Visiting UW–Madison, the two scholars and close friends from opposite ends of the political spectrum make the case for talking it out.

news.title: Universities of Wisconsin Board of Regents selects Tonjanita Johnson as next UWs president
news.summary_en: The Universities of Wisconsin Board of Regents selected Dr. Tonjanita (Tonja) L. Johnson as the next UWs President. Johnson is currently senior vice chancellor for academic and student affairs at the University of Alabama System.

news.title: Reminder: UW–Madison policies regarding inclement weather
news.summary_en: UW–Madison strives to remain open and maintain instruction whenever possible.
